expected_source: 286331152 is 0x11111110, the low 32 bits of the sum of the sixteen second-pass source words 0x02020202*(i+1) for i = 1..16 (0x02020202 * 136), computed by hand; the first pass sums to 0x88888888, which the program also checks. The value can only appear if the software GPIO edge raises GPINT0 and EDMA3 channel 48 runs the transfer. Both buffers are in L2 SRAM, which SPRU862B section 2.4.2 keeps coherent with L1D, so the L1D writeback and invalidate are not what makes the transfer correct: without the invalidate, or without both operations, the same value comes back at every optimisation level, measured. The writeback protects the program's own stack from its global invalidate - at -Os, dropping it alone returns -2
